text: Millionaire Frederick Loren [offers five strangers $10,000 each|trigger|saying yes to an offer] to stay the night in a rented house locked at midnight, a party for his wife Annabelle, whom he suspects of trying to poison him. The windows are barred, there are no phones, and the owner, Watson Pritchard, insists [the house is haunted by the murdered|threat|evil places], including his own brother. Each guest receives a gun, Annabelle is found hanging, and in the basement [a vat of acid|images|household objects and machines] waits for whoever has [planned a killing in the dark|wrong|love betrayed].
